description:
SURFACED by fz-yj0.5 audit, cross-checked in fz-yj0.4. NOT a regression (pre-existing), now FIXABLE after the GroundValue fold.

materialize_dispatch_const (src/compiler2/jobs/body.rs:~1970) maps DispatchConst::Utf8Binary(bytes) -> GroundValue::Binary(bytes.clone()), DROPPING the UTF-8 brand. This was structurally forced before fz-yj0.4 (old body::Literal had no Utf8Binary variant, so Utf8Binary always became Literal::Binary -- verified identical pre/post .4, zero regression). Now that GroundValue HAS a Utf8Binary variant, the collapse is a fixable violation of ground_value.rs's own load-bearing doc ('Binary and Utf8Binary ... must never be collapsed').

LATENT SPLIT: semantic.rs::dispatch_const_ty types a Utf8Binary dispatch const as str_t(), but the materialized VALUE carries no UTF-8 brand (it is a raw Binary). Type says str, value says raw bytes. No fixture catches this today (byte content is identical; brand is a type-level assertion), but it is a type/value inconsistency.

FIX: materialize_dispatch_const should map Utf8Binary -> GroundValue::Utf8Binary. This makes native.rs::lower_backend_literal's 'GroundValue::Utf8Binary => unreachable!()' arm (added by fz-yj0.4) LIVE, so it needs REAL backend handling -- route Utf8Binary through the same str/bitstring lowering path that receive.rs / dispatch_exec.rs already use for Utf8Binary dispatch consts. This is genuine new backend scope, deliberately NOT folded into .4 (which faithfully preserved pre-existing behavior).

VERIFY: a fixture that pattern-matches or dispatches on a string literal and observes its str-brand end-to-end; lib green; single-threaded fixture_matrix still exactly 19 (no new red). Belongs to the fz-yj0 epic.

comments.text:
WON'T-DO (user decision, 2026-07-06): type-erasure of Utf8Binary -> Binary at dispatch-const materialization is ACCEPTABLE here. Not folding.

BASIS (adversarial audit of the candidate fix, commit 42d1b81e4): the brand is NOT observable at this layer. Binary and Utf8Binary both -> str_t() in literal_ty, both -> ValueRef in literal_repr, both -> identical ConstBitstring/bitstring bytes in lower_backend_literal/literal_value, both excluded from literal_map_key. No downstream branch differs by tag. The candidate fix was pure IR-tag hygiene with zero behavior change (the new fixture would pass identically without it). So there is no observable type/value split to close -- dispatch_const_ty types it str, and the erased Binary value ALSO types str_t; type and value already agree.

PRESERVED CAVEAT (flag 3, from the audit): Binary -> str_t() is sound only by an accidental invariant -- every Expr::Binary/Pattern::Binary reaching these consumers is a lexer-UTF-8-guaranteed string literal (ast/mod.rs:49-53); no fz syntax currently produces a raw non-UTF-8 GroundValue::Binary here (bitstrings are a separate path). If a genuine raw-binary producer is ever routed through these sites, revisit typing Binary as str. Q5 tag-inconsistency (case path tags Utf8Binary; literal_from_pattern body.rs:3841 + AssertLiteral body.rs:2491 tag Binary) is MOOT under this erasure decision -- consistent-toward-Binary is fine.

Candidate commit 42d1b81e4 (branch wt/1cc, now deleted) recoverable via reflog if reversed. It included a salvageable behavior fixture fixtures2/behavior/case_map_string_key_dispatch.fz (a case matching %{"id" => v}) that PASSES on HEAD without the brand fix -- can be re-added as standalone coverage if desired.

title: Preserve the UTF-8 brand when materializing a Utf8Binary dispatch const (stop collapsing to Binary)
